clauses.clause: Groups on routes: road 2 × 6, countryside 3 × 6, shortcut 6 × 8 incl. 2 Alphas; each avoidable by a detour ≥ 20 m.
clauses.note: Actual native first admissions at both tiers confirm road2×6, countryside3×6 and shortcut6×8 including exactly2Alphas; independent observer-free final hashes match. Six complete real WASD detours (no god/teleport/actor changes) measure every trajectory segment: nearest group-anchor clearance24.5185m road,24.4233m countryside,30.0738m shortcut at each tier, all>=20m. Dense12tick samples reach scripted bridge approach. This is path offset around authored cohorts, not a claim that moving wanderers never contact the car.
